content: Cefuroxime axetil is the active ingredient in CEFTIN Tablets and CEFTIN for Oral Suspension. CEFTIN is a semisynthetic, broad-spectrum cephalosporin antibiotic designed for oral administration. Chemically, cefuroxime axetil is the 1-(acetyloxy) ethyl ester of cefuroxime, with the chemical name (RS)-1-hydroxyethyl (6R,7R)-7-[2-(Z)-(O-methyloxime)]-3-(hydroxymethyl)-8-oxo-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylate, 1-acetate 3-carbamate. Cefuroxime axetil exists in an amorphous form and has a specific structural formula. CEFTIN Tablets are film-coated and are available in strengths equivalent to either 250 mg or 500 mg of cefuroxime, provided as cefuroxime axetil. The inactive ingredients in CEFTIN Tablets include colloidal silicon dioxide, croscarmellose sodium, hydrogenated vegetable oil, hypromellose, methylparaben, microcrystalline cellulose, propylene glycol, propylparaben, sodium benzoate, sodium lauryl sulfate, and titanium dioxide. CEFTIN for Oral Suspension, when reconstituted with water, delivers cefuroxime (as cefuroxime axetil) in concentrations of either 125 mg or 250 mg per 5 mL of suspension. The inactive ingredients in CEFTIN for Oral Suspension include acesulfame potassium, aspartame, povidone K30, stearic acid, sucrose, tutti-frutti flavoring, and xanthan gum.
